project_type: Next.js 16 App Router with face-api.js emotion detection
build_command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/emociones-app && npm run build
verification_instructions: Run npm run build and confirm it completes without errors
setup_instructions: Node.js v22 via nvm is pre-installed. Run: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/emociones-app && npm install
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Must prefix all npm/node commands with nvm sourcing. Next.js 16 with AGENTS.md rule requiring checking node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for any API changes.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md mandates reading Next.js docs at node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. The project uses Tailwind CSS 4 with @tailwind directives in globals.css.
key_patterns: Client components use 'use client' directive. face-api.js models served from /public/models/. FaceDetector.tsx is the main detection component. Emotion types defined in src/lib/emotions.ts. Poems in src/lib/poems.ts with getRandomPoem(emotion) function.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. src/components/ - React components (FaceDetector.tsx main). src/lib/ - Utility modules (emotions.ts, poems.ts, ai-config.ts). public/models/ - face-api.js model weights. scripts/ - build/setup scripts.
